_about: Hand-kept notes for the content report (npm run report:content). An entry listed here is "supported with documented limits". moves: supported moves whose effect text has a part the battle engine leaves out on purpose (found with the same sentence rules as tools/import-moves.ts in the director's move list). species: anything the automatic checks cannot see.
